craft_notes: Sthāyin: mark-joy. Close: does. Rejected: 'omniscient' — killed: knows kept; 'creates' — killed: does kept.

lines: all he desires he knows and does.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tadāsyākṛtrimo dharmo jñatvakartṛtvalakṣaṇah | yatas tadepsitaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti ca karoti ca

reads_against.argmap: Then his unmade nature, marked by knowing-doing-ness; what he desires, he knows and does.
c1_essence: Unmade nature, knowing-doing-marked; desires all, knows and does.
